Our story so far

A few of my favourite moments

Jan 2020
The First Message
When I messaged a bunch of people through the grade 8 group chat, and somehow, you were one of the very first people to reply. Little did I know that one simple message would be the beginning of something amazing and beautiful. I had no idea that the girl replying to me that day would turn out to be the love of my life, my soulmate and a special part of my life.❤️
Aug 2020
When I started falling
Little by little, you started becoming someone I looked forward to talking to every day, especially during Covid. I started noticing the little things about you, thinking about you and smiling whenever I saw your name pop up on my phone. You were becoming someone I genuinely cared about.🥹
Oct 2020
The moment we told each other
After all the little conversations, the subtle hints, and all the feelings we had been keeping to ourselves, we finally found out that we both felt the same way.💞
1 May 2021
The moment it became official
That one night you messaged me after coming back from Ziggy and throwing hints that I should finally ask you to be mine. I was jumping up and down that night more nervous than I would like to admit but from that moment you weren’t just the girl I liked anymore you became my partner, my best friend and the person I want to make memories with.
June 2022
The parent breakfast
The morning our parents wanted to have breakfast, I remember it like it was yesterday. I was nervous sitting in my chair across from you, while you were laughing at me and taking pictures while our parents were sitting across from each other and speaking for the first time. Our love felt like something bigger than just the two of us, it was such a special moment for us and was a big step for us growing closer together.✨❤️
July 2022
The first time I came over
I was so nervous coming over for the first time, but this day will always hold such a special place in my heart. It was nothing like I was expecting. Your family welcomed me with the biggest, warmest arms, and from that day and now they are my second family, I never felt like a stranger in your home. Your mother especially made me feel so loved and accepted. She welcomed me into the family as if I had always been a part of it, and over time, she became so much more than just my girlfriend’s mother, she became a second mother to me. I’ll forever be grateful that she welcomed me into her family and gave me a place in her heart. 💖
2023-2026
Growing together
These years brought so many changes for both of us. We were growing up, figuring ourselves out and learning more about what it means to be there for each other. We experienced new things together, made countless memories and went through moments that tested us in ways we probably didn’t expect. There were good days, difficult days and everything in between, but through it all, we kept finding our way back to each other. And somehow, all those little moments brought us to where we are today. 🥹
September 2026
Where we are now
So much has changed since the beginning, but one thing hasn’t — you’re still the person I want beside me. We’ve grown from two people who simply liked each other into two people who have shared so much of life together. We’ve watched each other grow, celebrated the good times, stood by each other through the difficult ones, and created memories that I’ll carry with me forever. I’m grateful for every chapter that brought us here, for every memory, every laugh, every difficult conversation and every moment that made us stronger. ❤️✨
Little pictures, big memories

Us, through the years

A letter for you
untie the ribbon

Dear Kauthar

I love the person you are, but I also love the person I become when I’m with you. You make me feel understood, appreciated and loved in ways I can’t always put into words. You’re not only my girlfriend; you’re my best friend, my safe place, the person I want to tell everything to and the person I want beside me when life gets exciting, difficult or confusing.

I love the little things about you just as much as the big things. Your laugh, your smile, the way you talk, the little things you do without even realising them. I love our stupid conversations, our memories, our inside jokes and even the moments where we annoy each other. Somehow, all those little pieces of you have become some of my favourite parts of my life.

I don’t just love you for the memories we’ve already made. I love you for all the memories we still have waiting for us.

So yes, sometimes I hate the distance. Sometimes I wish our circumstances were different. But I would rather love you from far away than have a life where I never got to love you at all.

You are someone I will always be grateful for, someone I will always choose, and someone I hope I get to keep writing this story with.

I love you more than a letter, a screen or even a thousand words could ever explain. ❤️

Love

Muzzammil
Always

I love you, Kauthar ♡
